source_note: Expert episode 24 (layout 9 / style 9; target split, not the evaluation kitchen layout 1). Pan lifting and tilting were not re-executed with the executor; this is the expert recording with translated commands.
note: A pan with vegetables sits on the stove; a plate is on the counter to the side. The expert grasped the pan HANDLE from above (fingers down), lifted the pan, carried it over the plate, ROLLED the hand (~70 deg) to tip the vegetables onto the plate, rolled back, put the pan back on a burner, released and moved away. The robot must never touch the food itself. These commands are an approximate translation of a human recording, not re-executed.

turns.scene: Pan on the stove ahead with its handle towards the robot, about forward 48 at height ~97; plate on the counter to the right.
turns.plan: Move out over the pan handle with the fingers down.
Lift the pan clear of the stove and carry it towards the plate (right, closer to the robot).
Continue right until the pan is over the plate and start tilting.

turns.scene: Pan over the plate, slightly tilted.
turns.plan: Tilt further so the vegetables slide onto the plate.
Tilt the pan back level and lift it.

turns.scene: Empty pan level, between plate and stove.
turns.plan: Carry the pan back over the stove.
Set the pan down on the burner.
Move the gripper up and away from the pan.
